title: rubus koehleri var. distractus
intro: Rubus koehleri var. distractus, commonly known as the Korean black raspberry, is a variety of the Rubus genus that is native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus koehleri var. distractus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer agent, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and other phenolic compounds that are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
